mathematical_contract.degree_extension: The one rational multi-affine factor package accepts axis coefficient counts four through seven. A sextic split produces one proved linear-axis factor and an exact quintic quotient; no degree-specific positive assertion is added.
mathematical_contract.slice_authority: Exact rational specializations and signed maximal minors only propose bilinear slice factors. Exact Hypersolve division remains the authority for accepting each slice divisor.
mathematical_contract.bounded_fast_pass: The first proved top and anchor slice divisors receive one lift attempt. Failure makes no claim and replays the original exhaustive first-Taylor and two-anchor passes. Success still requires normalized exact division of the complete trivariate tensor.
mathematical_contract.fourth_sample_rejection: A factor reconstructed from any three exact roots predicts the fourth specialized root whenever its specialized axis coefficient is nonzero. Absence from a nonempty exact root set rejects the proposal; an empty or undecidable root set makes no negative claim.
mathematical_contract.lift: Both retained-coordinate orientations use the translated first-Taylor/highest-slice proof, with exact two-anchor projective alignment retained for repeated factors. Every candidate must divide the complete tensor exactly.
mathematical_contract.axis_scheduling: For quintic and sextic axes, exact nonzero counts in the leading slice order equally sized axes from denser to sparser. This is scheduling evidence only: unknown signs score zero and the selected axis supplies no mathematical claim.
mathematical_contract.selected_sign: The verified linear factor and exact quintic quotient enter the same bounded recursive sign authority. A selected zero factor proves the product zero; decided nonzero signs multiply exactly.
mathematical_contract.resource_bound: Dimensions are checked and all bivariate products and reconstructed tensors retain the 16384-control ceiling. The recursive split budget is five, sufficient for the supported sextic decomposition and no higher.
mathematical_contract.policy: A supportable rational sextic factorization is Certified under STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512 without terminal consumption. The septic control remains Predicate uncertainty in STRICT and returns Zero only after APPROXIMATE_512 records Approximate512Consumed.
mathematical_contract.failure: Missing exact rational roots, unresolved exact signs, failed slice or complete-tensor division, degenerate lift relations, unsupported coefficient towers, resource overflow, or exhaustion of the five-split budget makes no exact claim and falls through to the shared policy terminal. No tolerance, sampled positive assertion, compatibility shim, or second Boolean engine is introduced.

capability.differential_factor_coverage: Six distinct dense multi-affine factors reconstruct on every axis; F^2*G^2*H^2 multiplicity reconstructs on every axis; one rational factor is recovered with a quintic cofactor; an unfactored sextic is rejected.
